criteria_note: Scored A–F, G, U1, U2 (summary-specific) and X1 (paper taxonomy). R*, T*, S1 do not apply. Claims checked against https://arxiv.org/html/2511.21689v1 (full text incl. appendices; Figure 3 image was not available in the HTML). Blog lint/validator not run; G judged by reading front matter. Both posts list Gemma-3-27B as an unseen model although Appendix D lists gemma-3-27b-it among training tools; this follows the paper's own §6.3 wording, so it was not deducted.

A.reason: Clean five-part arc and valid Jekyll markup, but topic headings only ('## 연구 배경', '## 제안 방법' L19/L29) and a lone '### 주요 비교' (L73) as the only subsection of 실험 결과.

B.reason: Natural 입니다 register. Formulaic figure lead 'L23 결과는 아래와 같았습니다.' (rewrite: 'GPT-5와 Qwen3-8B의 호출 분포가 한쪽으로 쏠렸습니다.'); L43 is one 4-clause sentence that is hard to parse.

C.reason: Good seams (L35 '구조도에서 주목할 부분은'). L93 packs unseen tools, unseen pricing and preference results into one paragraph without transitions.

D.reason: Worked reward example is clearly labelled '설명용 가상 수치' (L51) and lands right after the formula. But it gives no cost for wrong trajectory C, so 'A가 1, B가 0으로 정규화' only holds if C's cost lies between; the reader is not told.

E.reason: Table cells match Table 1 exactly, figures placed where discussed and never cited by number. Table note L85 '도구 없음 구성과 Llama 계열 일부 행은 생략' understates the cut: basic-tool Qwen3-8B/235B and SOTA rows are also dropped.

F.reason: All 30+ numbers match the paper. One unsupported assertion stated as fact: L99 '성능의 상당 부분은 여전히 GPT-5 같은 프런티어 모델 호출에서 나오므로' (no ablation; GPT-5 is ~1.6 of 8.2 calls, Table 15).

G.reason: use_math true with $$ math; description 146 chars > title (80), opens with 'ToolOrchestra', numbers 37.1/35.1/2.5배 all in TL;DR. (Blog lint not run.)

U1.reason: Motivation (pilot bias), method (reward, GRPO), implementation (hyperparams, ToolScale), results, significance all covered.

U2.reason: Three-sentence plain-prose TL;DR, one distilled results table, grounded limitations; ~5,350 chars body.

X1.reason: Category ok. Tags mostly paper terms; 'Synthetic-Tool-Use-Environments' is a coined phrase (paper: 'user-agent-tool environments', 'synthetic dataset'), and 'Reasoning-Models' is a second controlled tag the paper is not about.

claim headings.evidence: All H2s are topic names (L19 '연구 배경', L57 '구현 방식', L95 '의의와 한계').

running example.evidence: Pilot-bias story (L23-27) is picked up again in results (L87 GPT-5-mini 5.6 calls), but the A/B/C reward example (L51) is used once.

mechanism→design→formula→example.evidence: L37-53: reward vector → formula → hypothetical A/B/C → '고정 가중치로 섞지 않고' design reason.

facts said once.evidence: 30.2→9.2 cents and 37.1 stated in TL;DR/table/L87 only; no section re-lists numbers.

numbers with scope and unit.evidence: L85 states cost/latency averaged over HLE+FRAMES and HLE text-only; but L93 '비용은 102.4 대 34.8' has no unit.

nothing invented.evidence: Example labelled hypothetical (L51); but L99 frontier-dependence claim lacks support.

writer's own assessment.evidence: L99: no RL-trained or routing baselines, no reward ablation, GPT-5 judge, relative preference metric.

length fitted to difficulty.evidence: Most space on reward design (L37-55); background brief.

type-specific shape.evidence: TL;DR, five sections, one results table.

Korean style.evidence: Consistent 입니다; minor formulaic L23 '결과는 아래와 같았습니다'.

details.tags-not-in-paper: avoided: none of 'Multi-Objective-Reward', 'ToolScale-Dataset', 'Cost-Aware-Reinforcement-Learning'; tags (L11) 'Efficiency-Aware-Reward', 'User-Preference-Alignment', 'Orchestrator-Model' map to abstract terms ('efficiency-, and user-preference-aware rewards', 'orchestrator model'). structure_defects_detail: L73 lone H3 '### 주요 비교' as the only subsection of 실험 결과
L93 broken seam: three different generalization/preference results crammed into one paragraph
top_issues: L99 unsupported claim that much of the performance still comes from frontier-model calls
L51 worked example omits trajectory C's cost so the stated min-max values are not determined; L85 table note misstates which rows were dropped

A.reason: Valid markup; results split into three meaningful H3s (L69, L85, L91); limitations as labelled bullets. H2s remain topic names.

B.reason: Natural overall. Formulaic 'L49 예시 값으로 보면 이해가 쉽습니다.' (rewrite: drop it and start with '정확도와 비용만 중시하는 사용자를 가정합니다'); L83 'GPT-5-mini로 기본 위임하는 편향' is a calque of 'defaulting to' (rewrite: 'GPT-5-mini에 습관적으로 맡기는 편향').

C.reason: L27 ends the pilot paragraph with an unrelated sentence 'L27 비용 효율과 사용자 선호에 따른 제어 가능성도 기존 도구 에이전트 연구에서 거의 다뤄지지 않았습니다.' — a broken seam. Otherwise good transitions.

D.reason: L49 example ties cost normalization to the tool-preference use case (confidential data → local tools), well placed. Same unstated-batch caveat: 'L49 정규화 후 싼 궤적은 비용 항에서 1점' holds only if no other trajectory in the batch is cheaper/pricier.

E.reason: Table cells match Table 1 incl. the useful no-tool GPT-5 row with ∗ footnote (L73, L81); figures described not numbered; call-share percentages derived correctly from Table 15. Merging tool config into the model column (L71) departs slightly from the source layout.

F.reason: Numbers check out, including derived call shares. One wrong-scope claim: L104 '학습 데이터, 도구 설명, 선호 쌍을 모두 LLM이 생성·검증' (GeneralThought-430K is external; contradicts L55). L27 '약 66%' is not verifiable from the text (Appendix A gives 98% GPT-5 or GPT-5-mini).

G.reason: use_math true; description 132 chars > title, opens with 'ToolOrchestra', numbers from TL;DR only. (Blog lint not run.)

U1.reason: All five questions covered; adds the τ² 40%-of-steps fact and pricing generalization numbers.

U2.reason: Plain TL;DR, one distilled table, six grounded limitations; ~5,480 chars body.

X1.reason: Repeats the flagged tags: 'Multi-Objective-Reward' (term absent from the paper) and 'ToolScale-Dataset' (L11), plus coined 'Efficiency-Aware-Reinforcement-Learning' (variant of flagged 'Cost-Aware-Reinforcement-Learning') and the unrelated second controlled tag 'Reasoning-Models'.

claim headings.evidence: H2s are topic names; H3s like '비용-성능 곡선과 도구 분포' (L85) are topic noun phrases, not claims.

running example.evidence: Pilot bias (L27) is revisited with call shares (L89), and the confidential-user case links L49 to preference pairs; no single example threads the post.

mechanism→design→formula→example.evidence: L35-49: vector → formula → '핵심' design reason (wrong answers get 0, so cost cannot buy away correctness) → numeric example.

facts said once.evidence: Cost/latency numbers appear in table and once in L83; limitations do not restate results.

numbers with scope and unit.evidence: L81 scopes cost/latency; L89 says shares averaged over three benchmarks; but L93 '비용 34.8', '비용 81.3', '비용 7.5' lack units.

nothing invented.evidence: L104 overgeneralizes LLM-generated data; L27 66% not in text.

writer's own assessment.evidence: L102 hedged judgment that baseline prompt design may inflate the margin; L106 dependence on API price structure.

length fitted to difficulty.evidence: Reward design gets the most space; background is two paragraphs.

type-specific shape.evidence: TL;DR, five sections, one results table.

Korean style.evidence: Consistent 입니다; minor formulaic L49 and calque L83.

preference.reason: Both are accurate, well-sized summaries with matching tables and one unsupported/wrong claim each. Y has the better-organized results section (no-tool row, τ² 40%-of-steps fact, correctly derived call shares, pricing numbers) and clearer labelled limitations; X has fewer seams, a clearly labelled hypothetical example, and tags that avoid the human-flagged defect Y repeats. The strengths offset; mean scores 8.60 vs 8.50.
